source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of blackbody radiation (PDF 172-174).

blocks.text: Jab kisi cheez ko garam kiya jaye to woh chamakne lagti hai aur radiation ki shakal mein energy chhorti hai. Yeh radiation sirf cheez ke temperature par depend karti hai, us ke material (jis cheez se bani hai) ya shape par nahi. Temperature barhne par cheez ka rang halka laal, phir chamakdar peela aur phir safed ho jata hai. Is ka matlab hai ke radiation lambi wavelengths (infrared) se chhoti wavelengths (ultraviolet) ki taraf shift ho rahi hai (khisak rahi hai). Lekin asal cheezen saari radiation poori tarah absorb (andar le lena) ya emit (bahar nikalna) nahi karti, is liye un ko theek theek study karna mushkil hai. Is ko samajhne ke liye scientists aik ideal (perfect, sirf sochi hui) cheez maante hain jise blackbody kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Do stars barabar roshan nazar aate hain. Aik standard candle hai jis ki asal chamak maloom hai; doosre ki nahi. Agar standard candle zyada door ho to doosre star ki asal chamak ke bare mein kya keh sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Doosra star qareeb hai lekin utna hi roshan nazar aata hai, is liye us ki asal chamak (luminosity) standard candle se kam hai. Kitni kam: dono ke faaslon ki ratio (nisbat) ke square ke hisaab se (L ∝ d², jab F barabar ho).

blocks.title: Blackbody
blocks.text: Blackbody woh cheez hai jo us par girne wali saari radiation absorb kar leti hai, aur har wavelength par radiation poori tarah emit bhi karti hai.

Asal zindagi mein blackbody ki achhi misal aik hollow cavity (andar se khali dabba) hai jis mein chhota sa soorakh ho aur andar ki deewarein kaali hon (Fig. 21.3). Andar ki deewaron par kaala carbon soot (kalikh) laga hota hai taake woh radiation achhi tarah absorb karein aur andar hi andar reflect karein (lautayein).

blocks.alt: Moti kaali gol deewar jis ke daen taraf chhota soorakh hai. Aik ray (roshni ki lakeer) soorakh se andar aa kar baar baar reflect hoti hai; us ka raasta nau-konay star jaisa banta hai aur woh bahar nahi nikal pati.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.3: perfect ya ideal blackbody (kitab ki Figure 21.3 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Jab radiation chhote soorakh se andar aati hai to andar takrati rehti hai aur phans jati hai. Agar is cavity ko kafi zyada temperature tak garam karein to yeh har wavelength ki radiation emit karne lagti hai. Isi ko blackbody radiation kehte hain. Is radiation ka pattern sirf blackbody ke temperature par depend karta hai. Temperature barhne par nikalne wali energy bhi barhti hai. Jab hum is radiation ki intensity (taqat) ko wavelength ke against graph par banate hain (Fig. 21.4) to dekhte hain ke temperature barhne par curve ki peak (sab se oonchi jagah) chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisakti hai. Yani zyada garam blackbody chhoti wavelengths par zyada energy emit karti hai.

blocks.alt: Wavelength (0 se 3.0 micrometre) ke against radiation intensity ka graph, T = 5000, 4000, 3000 aur 2000 K ke liye. Har curve peak tak uth kar aahista girta hai; garam curve ooncha aur chhoti wavelength par peak wala. Peaks ke dots neeli line se jure hain. Dashed lines ke darmiyan visible hissa rangeen hai, baen Ultraviolet aur daen Infrared; axis par lambda max ke nishan.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.4: blackbody radiation ke spectra (kitab ki Figure 21.4 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har curve ki peak (λmax) Wien's law λmax T = 2.9 × 10⁻³ m K se aati hai: 5000 K par taqreeban 0.58 μm, 4000 K par 0.72 μm, 3000 K par 0.97 μm aur 2000 K par 1.45 μm. Kitab ke graph mein peaks thori baen taraf chhapi hain (maslan 2000 K ki taqreeban 1.2 μm par); hum ne inhein sahi jagah lagaya hai. Curves ki oonchai sirf andaza hai, scale par nahi.

blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Blackbody radiation ko poori tarah absorb bhi karti hai aur emit bhi. Cosmic microwave background (universe mein har taraf se aane wali halki microwave radiation) ka spectrum taqreeban bilkul blackbody jaisa hai. Hum insan bhi infrared mein blackbody radiation emit karte hain, isi liye night-vision (infrared) camera andhere mein hamein dekh lete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke 'Do you know?' box mein likha hai ke microwave oven bhi blackbody jaisa hai. Yeh ghalat hai: oven ki microwaves magnetron (aik electronic device) se aik hi frequency (taqreeban 2.45 GHz) par aati hain, kisi garam cheez ki blackbody radiation se nahi. Blackbody jaisa spectrum cosmic microwave background ka hai. Kitab 'night-vision bat' (chamgadar) bhi likhti hai; hamein andhere mein night-vision (thermal infrared) cameras aur goggles dekhte hain, chamgadar nahi (chamgadar awaz ki goonj se raasta dhoondti hai).

blocks.prompt: Do cheezen alag alag temperature tak garam ki jati hain. Aik red-hot (laal garam) aur doosri white-hot (safed garam) chamakti hai. Kaun zyada garam hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: White-hot cheez zyada garam hai. Us ki peak chhoti wavelengths ki taraf khisak gayi hai, is liye woh poore visible hisse (laal se violet tak) mein tez roshni deti hai jo mil kar safed lagti hai. Red-hot cheez zyada tar lambi (laal) wavelengths par roshni deti hai.
